integrity: The proof separates vertex-cover necessity from edge-resolution necessity. Two omitted leaves sharing a center create indistinguishable pendant edges, while center omission forces all incident leaves into a vertex cover. Those conditions are also sufficient by an explicit case analysis separating pendant edges from each other and from the central edge. Counting the three possible center selections yields the polynomial.
scientific_limitations: The all-generator theorem is restricted to double stars.

The scalar value for balanced double stars is already implied by the published uniform-caterpillar example; the new claim is the full generator classification and enumerator, including unequal leaf counts.
Finite exhaustive verification covers one through five leaves on each side and is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed all-generator classification may exist.
title: Dominant edge metric generator polynomial of double stars
